subject: maths
title: Vector Vista
description: Master magnitude, unit vectors and position vectors.

concepts.def: Column vectors (a,b,c) or i,j,k form: ai+bj+ck.
v/|v| has length 1 in the same direction as v.
OP is the vector from origin O to point P.

mcqs.q: What is the magnitude of the vector (3, 4)?
options: The magnitude is 12 — you multiply the components.
The magnitude is 7 — you add the components.
9xy, by adding all the numbers and merging the letters.
5 — using sqrt(3^2 + 4^2).

mcqs.q: If the dot product of two non-zero vectors is zero, what does that mean?
options: The magnitude is 12 — you multiply the components.
The vectors are perpendicular to each other.
It means at least one of the vectors is the zero vector.
It means the vectors are parallel.
9xy, by adding all the numbers and merging the letters.
8xy, by combining all terms regardless of variable.
The magnitude is 12 — you multiply the components.
5x + 3y — combine like terms (3x + 2x and 4y - y).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Scalar multiplication”?
options: v/|v| has length 1 in the same direction as v.
OP is the vector from origin O to point P.
k(a,b)=(ka,kb), scales magnitude by |k|.
Add corresponding components: (1,2)+(3,4)=(4,6).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Adding vectors”?
options: Column vectors (a,b,c) or i,j,k form: ai+bj+ck.
|v| = √(a²+b²+c²) for v = (a,b,c).
v/|v| has length 1 in the same direction as v.
Add corresponding components: (1,2)+(3,4)=(4,6).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Vector notation”?
options: Column vectors (a,b,c) or i,j,k form: ai+bj+ck.

k(a,b)=(ka,kb), scales magnitude by |k|.
OP is the vector from origin O to point P.
